reviews.comment: He is by far one of the best professors I have ever had. I remember first lecture he mentioned his assignments were going to be anywhere between 15-25 hours long and I thought he was exaggerating but he was not. Make sure you go to his office and make a connection with him, he is willing to be there for you and make sure you succeed.

Oh,where to start. What they say about you is in fact true. The all-nighters, the crash outs, the silly little questions you ask, its all true.This class indeed required my blood, sweat and tears but it was all worth it. He is so well respected in the industry you might as well put his class on the resume. I will forever keep your class in my heart

Mr. Boldt, how I will never forget that first quiz that I took for your class, I got a 5% on it. I will never forget the long nights I spent preparing for exams and doing homework, Mr. Boldt really does care about you, and this class is the most rewarding class I have taken. Work hard and it will be rewarded, and ask for help when needed.

I was warned coming into A&M that Boldt was an intense professor. That was an understatement. But after countless all-nighters, hard work, and a lot of stress, I can say whole heartedly that this class is the most fulfilling classes I have ever taken. Boldt truly cares about every student, their well-being, and how much they learn from his class.

Oh Gary. The first quiz humbled me so fast I started looking at other majors. Homework takes forever, attendance matters, and he runs the class like a superintendent. But if you put the work in, he genuinely wants you to succeed. Half the class is learning construction and the other half is surviving Gary lore.

Probably the hardest class I've ever taken at TAMU; but 100% worth it. Prof Boldt is probably the most knowledgeable prof in construction at this university and by far has one of the best teaching styles, even though it's super unorthodox. He teaches you how to read plans, how to be detail oriented and how to have honor and respect among others.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Boldt is amazing, he truly cares for all of his students and will do everything in his power to help you succeed, IF you want it. Your effort is reflected in your grade though. He has a saying at the beginning of year “everyone passes”, and that holds true (even when you fail your first assignments). Go to office hours, and build a relationship!!

This has been the most difficult class I've taken, but the most rewarding. He sees greatness and everyone and works hard for all of us to find it. There likely isn't a class more challenging or a teacher who will be more hard on you. There also isn't a teacher more willing to work with you, or genuinely cares more about your success.

COSC 175 is not as bad as people thought. Make sure you follow his instructions. WHAT HE SAYS GOES! The class is structured around 6 quizzes, 6 home works and 3 test. It is extremely important to get in groups and work together. Hard work is what it is going to take to get a B maybe A in the class. Gary Cares for you I pinky Promise! Goodluck!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Just be ready to stay up past midnight for a couple homework's or more, don't worry when you fail the first quiz, and do things exactly as he says. There is plenty of opportunity to at least get yourself a B in this class.

Its a shame professor Boldt isn't teaching 375 anymore. For all of you freshman that see him on your degree plan for the new 175 class, BUCKLE UP. Like everyone else says in here, the class will seem impossible but if you just put in the countless hours and nights your grade will reflect that. Make sure to go in his office and come prepared.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Don't let the rumors get to your head. Boldt truly care about his students. Is it the hardest and most time consuming class you'll ever take ? Yes. But you'll learn more than you ever have. Take Boldt if you truly care to learn. You will pass if you show up everyday and put in the work.

Oh Gary where do I even begin. It is the day after bid day currently and what I went through yesterday felt like WWII from the trenches. From late nights to early mornings, this class will be gone but never forgotten,(maybe.) Fall students, you are in for a great ride!
PS (take this class in the summer...even though you spend over 200 hours a week)
I liked Boldt. However, Reveille barked in his class and he didn't dismiss us. Smh.

This may just be the most time consuming class you will ever take. The amount of hours put into this class seems impossible. Do not procrastinate or wait to start until after an addendum is given because he may never actually release one. The night before the semester project be ready to stay up all night. Prof. Boldt is a great guy but very tough.

Hardest things you will ever have to do in life: 
1. Bury your parents 
2. Estimating II
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The GOAT. if you want to succeed in construction take this class. If not you'll be so lost in the construction sphere.Great guy who actually cares about making his students better. Toughest class ever but I wouldn't trade it for the world. Interviewed with Burns&Mac, first question was if I took Boldt's class. Wouldn't hire without it.

This was the worst semester of my life. Little to no sleep every night causing my grades in other classes to suffer. That being said this has been the best class I have ever taken. There will be times when you don't think you can get through it but you will. Professor Boldt made all of us realize we can accomplish way more than we think.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have ever taken. It tested me mentally beyond my belief. Work hard or you won't make it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: All of yall rating him in April acting like yall had it challenging need to count your blessings. None of yall had the 8:00 AM lecture it was changed to 11:00 or something like that. They made the class easier. But. congrats. But take him hes the best.

Do not take the other professor unless you are a coward who doesn't want to learn anything from your tenure at A&M. Boldt's class will be the single most challenging thing you do, but at the same time, it will be the most beneficial thing you will ever do for yourself. Take the class, hunker down, get to work; it is worth every hour you spend.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: My oh my where do I even begin, Gary, my prince, my king. His class will be something you dread but look forward to. His class is worth the challenge it presents, I have never learned as much in one semester as I did in Boldt's class. Don't take the easy way out by taking the other professor, you don't gain anything. Challenge yourself with Boldt.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Gary is one of the most genuine men you will ever meet. He will give you anything from life advice to concrete calculations. If you choose another professor for this class, you aren't a real man.
If you take COSC 375 with any other prof your degree does not count.

I can legitimately say I would rather be sent back to Marine Corps boot camp than take this course again. You will be given tasks so impossible it will take an act of God to finish them. You will hate Gary Boldt then love him. Bid day is Omaha beach and you are pinned down by heavy machinegun fire. May God and Boldt have mercy on your soul.

Well what can I say... This might be the hardest class you ever take. This class requires all-nighters and long hours. Boldt demands that put in everything that you got. However, this might be the most rewarding class you take. 

Don't go at it alone. Find people to work with. Don't take more than 15 hours. Talk to Boldt regularly.
If you are reading this right now it is the night before your first class. All of you are in for a crazy semester. Have fun because it will suck.

This was literally the hardest class I have ever taken but it was also the most rewarding. Boldt cares about his students like they are his own family. His lectures will make you proud to be an Aggie as well as an American. He is a harsh grader with very high expectations but he is very fair. He will answer any question you can ever think of.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Boldt is what keeps A&M's COSC Department alive. He is a very well-rounded individual that comes off mysterious at first but at the end of the semester you will appreciate him. Work hard, pull all-nighters in Francis Hall multiple times, talk to him in his office. Most of all show him respect and he will do the same for you. 🐐

Estimating 2 is hard. Boldt takes a real world experience, turns it up a couple notches, and throws it at you at 100 mph. Assignments are difficult, nights can drag on, and this class will take over your life if you don't manage it properly. However, Boldt is an amazing professor. You'll never know what's next, but work hard and you'll be rewarded.

Its currently the day before bid day. Im kinda chilling tbh. Other than fact that most of my numbers are probably wrong... But the good thing is im not gonna be up at 4:30 am this time. If you take class dont say I didnt warn u.

I had real-world estimating experience and this class was still challenging. Don't be like everyone else and complain, this class is HARD, it is tedious, but I worked two jobs, took 18 total hours and still got an A. My biggest flex ever ngl. Show up early to lecture & lab, get to know Prof. Boldt. Don't overthink & get a good group to work with.

Professor Boldt is a proud Aggie who loves Texas A&M, which is awesome. His class will push your ability to handle stress/workloads beyond what you have experienced in college. Just a heads-up: he may try to deceive you or play mind games intentionally. In my experience, he exploited students, myself included, which led me to lose respect for him.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is tough, probably the hardest class you will take, but you will be shocked how much you learn without even realizing it.

This is not an estimating class. This is a free trial to the real world. It is hard and there will be all-nighters, but the point is to learn to either ask for help, or grind until you figure it out on your own. Both are valuable skills to bring to the industry. Don't let him scare you. Ask for help and show effort and you'll be fine.

Gary Boldt is the single greatest professor at Texas A&M University. He mimics the high stress environment that  the estimating world brings.
I felt like I was pledging my life to COSC during this class and I have never worked so hard in my life. This class is tough, it is not impossible, show that you care, buy in, and you will be just fine.

Everything you have heard is true. Professor Boldt is truly the greatest teacher I have ever had. He genuinely cares for all of his students, wants you to succeed, and is not afraid to push you to a breaking point. Go to his office and ask questions. I learned more in this course than I have in all my other classes combined. Sharpen your pencils!

I've had to talk my friends off ledges while they took this class. The content is not hard, rather he does everything to make it nearly impossible. There should never be a class that calls for a 8-5 workload in this category. I will never forget what he put me and my friends through, and his position teaching this class should be reconsidered.
the Greatest to ever teach it.
A one-man thrill ride. HOlLY. Strap in and enjoy, goes by fast. Maybe Estimating 2 was the friends we made along the way...

Gary Boldt is the rockstar of the Construction Science program. I have never been challenged more by a professor than Boldt, and I would not trade any of the pain for the lessons learned in this class. His lectures make me want to wave the American flag from the top of Kyle field with an AR-15. Sharpen your pencils!
Everything you heard is true. Makes the class more difficult each semester. If you're reading this, you're probably cooked. Good luck :)

Currently 4 AM, 1 day before bid day. Rethinking life at the moment. At this point why do I pay rent if I spend all my time on campus? This might just be rock bottom. Bid blindness is a real thing. We are the Russian Sleep Experiment ran by Boldt. Boldt is the toughest but greatest professor I've had. He's the true rockstar.

Professor Boldt is truly a legend to the construction science department here at Texas A&M. While this may be the most difficult class for many COSC graduates, it is the most rewarding. Start assignments as soon as you get them and don't be discouraged when he throws a curve ball. This man deserves an award. He's tough, but so is life.

COMPANY MEMO No. 1 - 12-06-2023 
1st Item: The boss wanted to let you know that grown dudes will cry on bid day. 
2nd Item: The boss wanted to let you know the subcontractor don't bid til after lunch. 
3rd Item: Ladies and Gentlemen, sharpen your pencils, the boss wants this job! His best to you, good luck! 
THIS CONCLUDES COMPANY MEMO No. 1.

One of the most outstanding classes to take in the COSC major. Get ready to question your sanity whilst staying up til 3 a.m. more days than you can count (probably a few if you don't slack off lol). The biggest tool you can come in with is the knowledge of how to format Excel and asking LOTS of questions even if they aren't answered.

This class is extremely hard and very detailed oriented. However, Boldt is the best professor I've ever had. He teaches in a way that I wish every professor would. His class is very stressful, but if you put in the effort you will be rewarded in the end. I highly recommend Professor Boldt, he cares about your success
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Respected

reviews.comment: Professor Boldt will prepare you for the real world. While taking this class you want to pull your hair out but in the end, you will realize how much you have learned and how much respect Boldt has for all of his students on a personal level. Furthermore, take advantage of the knowledge he shares with you.

Boldt's class is hard but the most important thing is that you have to try. If you don't you will fail. DO NOT WAIT TO DO ASSIGNMENTS. This is the most critical thing you have to do to do well in his class. Start early and ask him questions. Sometimes he will make you feel like your question is dumb but he will always help you out so you succeed.

*This is for summer only* Do NOT take this course in the summer if you have a job. Listen to me, because I tried to do it. I got lucky my work let me take a leave of absence. The duration of this class was 30 days and I pulled at least 14 all nighters. That being said, Boldt genuinely wants you to succeed. Do not cheat yourself by not taking him.

Professor Boldt will teach you a lot about construction and a lot about yourself. He challenges you more than you could ever imagine, and you come out such a better student and person in the end. Even though it was the hardest class of my life it was my best professor.
An absolute roller coaster of a class. I learned more in this course than I have in all my other classes combined. It's hard, but not overbearing. Don't be afraid to go to his office hours.

Prof. Boldt is a great guy. I had him for estimating 2(most work Ive ever put in a class) and had the opportunity to take him for scheduling. Went about as expected. Spent hours on homework, high stress, and late nights, but at the end I can make a schedule. After talking to other students who had a different professor,I would choose boldt any day

My favorite professor of all time. His class is a lot of work so be ready but he is an amazing human, he is available 24/7 (literally). Go to all the lectures and labs, put in the work, and I promise you that you won't fail because he won't let that happen to you. Do what's asked and ASK QUESTIONS!! He is a gem, and you'll learn to appreciate him.

Boldt is one amazing human/best professor world wide. You can trust him with your life & is available 24/7. Extreme amount of work daily and be prepared to feel as if you are not doing enough. If you do what is asked from you and try your best you will not fail. Professor Boldt is very understanding so ask questions and go to his office hrs!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Boldt cares about his students a ton and it shows. Ive never had a professor that encourages me more and then rips me into shreds with schoolwork, but hes ready to answer a phone call or text 24/7 and wants to help. He challenges you and makes you want to quit. I would take him for every class if I could.

This is probably the hardest class in the construction science program, but I would say hes probably the most knowledgeable professor in the program. This class alone is enough stress so plan to take easy classes with it. Do not take Law 1, MEP, and structures with this class. Its complete misery and youll consider dropping out almost everyday.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Top notch human being all around. Extreme amounts of stress but the material will stick with you like it never has before. Hardest college class Ive taken by far. Buckle up and get ready, DO NOT wait to the last minute (week prior) on assignments. Youll get a real taste of change orders as well and your first true understanding of bid day.

I respect the guy for being an exceptional person. In the classroom however, in the midst of the coronavirus pandemic there was no mercy given in regard to the difficulty. I had moments where I literally felt the stress in my heart. It's doable but my word of advice, do not take take the full load of Project Mgmt & Structures with it, it's suicide.

Although professor Boldt is a great guy and helps students when they have questions, the amount of work and anxiety this class brings is unhealthy. He fails to realize that this isn't our only class and that we have priorites outside of school. He doesn't really teach material rather just tells you what to do and then you are on your own. Stressful
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I don't understand all the good reviews about him, I have never met a more unfit person to be a teacher in my life. He is very unclear about everything and tells us to teach each other. prof's are required to have a zoom option bc of pandemic, but he requires class in person and says we "better have covid" and makes fun of us if we are using zoom.

Top notch human being, all around. This man has a whole psychological roller coaster of a class set up. If you're reading this, then you probably have to take him regardless. Buckle up and prepare yourself for the COSCI rite of passage that is Estimating 2. I would probably change majors if I had to retake this class but you got this, or whatever.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Rarely do I give 5s on both options. Bold is the best teacher no doubt a bout it that I've had so far in Cosc. This class will eat you up like a tiger and spit you out an estimator. Prepare for high stress and contemplating dropping out. Good luck.

If you don't have the mental toughness of a Navy Seal dear god don't take this class. George Bush should've sent Prof Boldt to assign terrorists Estimating projects, the war would've ended on 09/12/01. If Chuck Norris and Gary Boldt met, there would be one less redhead in TX. If you don't contemplate dropping out and living as a hippie, he failed.

I would have given him 1 star at the start of estimating 2, but that is how he teaches. He makes it seem like he is not afraid to fail everyone, but in reality if you put the work in you will at least pass. He cares a lot about what he does and it shows. I would avoid taking him bc its a LOT of work but this class was overall beneficial.

I wasted money on this class. I tend to earn solid As and a few Bs. I honestly did not learn a thing. I started out strong in this class working hard 2 hours or more per day outside of class. I learned quickly that if I would go to the bar after class he would give all the answers out the next class. He is all about playing stupid mind games.

Gary is a very tough professor that deeply cares for your success. However, he is unconventional and will be very intimidating your first time in class. Do exactly what he says for homework and READ his assignments carefully. You will get frustrated at times but he gladly welcomes office visits to help you be successful!

Mr. Boldt is the best professor I have had. He gives extremely long assignments and he asks a lot of you but the class is a great learning experience. He is always in his office and he puts in even more time than the students. Would take again.

I have never put so much effort and time into a class. I learned so much from this class and I know that the huge amount of stress and work was worth it. It really felt like a real life work scenario. He is passionate about our education and he has a lot of knowledge. He is a very relatable and down-to-earth man. I respect him a lot.

Professor Boldt is straight out of the industry and prepares his students for the real world unlike any professor I've had. There are many assignments you will have to complete that will take a very long time to complete if you want to do it the right way. You will have to work hard and apply yourself but there is a reason for everything he does.

Great professor, genuinely concerned with the success of his students. If a student does not do well with Boldt, it is their own fault. He is always willing and able to help his students. His class had some busy work, but nothing too extreme.

Good professor, just make sure that you don't sleep through the 8AM lecture. Attendance isn't required, but he grades you at the end to see if you have all the notes.  If you feel like you don't understand what he is asking you to do for a project, don't be afraid to ask him, he's one of the nicest professors I've ever had.
